newsitem.title: USA: PECO reduces power at Pa. nuke -- NRC.
newsitem.headline: PECO reduces power at Pa. nuke -- NRC.

text.p: PECO Energy Co's 1,100 megawatt (MW) Peach Bottom nuclear unit 2 in Delta, Pa., was reduced to about 15-20 percent power, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission reported Wednesday.
"They have it down to 15 to 20 percent while doing work on the turbine," said an NRC spokeswoman.
The NRC could not comment on when the unit would begin increasing power again. "It depends on how the work goes," she said.
PECO was not available for comment.
The unit, which was shut September 13 for a scheduled 30-day maintenance outage, was in the process of ramping up and near full capacity when power was reduced.
